title: Burning and Suppression of Solids — II (BASS-II)
objectives: Characterize ignition, flame growth, spread, and extinction limits of solid fuels in weak forced flow; compare these results with normal-gravity flammability screening and provide data for future fire-safety experiments.
approach: Carry out crew-assisted burning tests in a small wind tunnel installed inside the ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox. Mount rods, sheets, films, and other geometries; vary airflow up to approximately 40 cm/s and reduce oxygen concentration by nitrogen dilution. Image and assess flame appearance and spread in concurrent and opposed flow.
